text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr achieved a brilliant 
victory in the Yasuda Kinen. With this, 
she has accomplished the first of her 
goals toward conquering three distance 
categories.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she couldn't celebrate forever. 
Her next goal was the second leg of her 
"Three-Division Conquest": the sprint 
race, the Sprinters Stakes.
